document: ASHRAE 62.2-2019 (required by DBC 2021 K.10.1.6), with DBC K.10.1.7-K.10.1.10

rules.title: Whole-dwelling ventilation rate
rules.requirement: Mechanical outdoor air Qtot = 0.15 x floor area (m2) + 3.5 x (bedrooms + 1) L/s.

rules.title: Local exhaust in kitchens and bathrooms
rules.requirement: A local mechanical exhaust system in each kitchen and bathroom.

rules.title: Demand-controlled exhaust rates
rules.requirement: Bathroom 25 L/s; kitchen vented range hood 50 L/s (other kitchen exhaust fans 150 L/s or 5 ach for enclosed kitchens).

rules.title: Continuous exhaust rates
rules.requirement: Bathroom 10 L/s; enclosed kitchen 5 ach based on kitchen volume.

rules.title: Natural ventilation not relied upon
rules.requirement: Natural ventilation through windows and doors is permitted but shall not be relied upon for ventilation and thermal comfort.

rules.title: Bathroom fan interlock
rules.requirement: Bathroom / toilet extract fans controlled through the light switch, timers or sensors.

rules.title: Kitchen range hood ducting
rules.requirement: Range hoods discharge outdoors through smooth, airtight metal ducts with a backdraft damper, unless ductless with other mechanical ventilation provided.
